findings.citation_text: More recent work has focused on millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar [87], [88], [89], [90], [91], [92], [93], [94], Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) [95], or by collecting RF emanations from a microphone [96]. Across these studies, the average source-to-attacker distance is about 3.6 m, with some systems reaching up to 8 m [88], [92]. The accuracy of the speech recognition can be as high as 0.94 at 1 m [95] or WER = 0.06 at 2 m [96].
